activity.notes: Amda Seyon I (also rendered Amda Tsiyon/Tseyon) is securely documented as a Solomonic emperor of Ethiopia reigning from 1314 to 1344. ATLAS reuses the existing Ethiopian Empire polity used for other Solomonic emperors.

sources.title: King Amda Tsiyon (r.1314-1344) territorial expansion to the kingdom of Hadiya, South West Ethiopia
sources.citation_text: Peer-reviewed historical study identifying Amda Tsiyon as ruler from 1314 to 1344 and examining his campaigns and expansion.
